acct_email_reset_intro: Hi {name}, someone asked to reset the password of your BudgetMaster account.
acct_email_reset_outro: The link works for one hour. If it was not you, ignore this email; your password stays the same.
acct_email_verify_intro: Hi {name}, confirm that this is your email address, so you can reset your password if you ever forget it.
acct_email_verify_outro: If you did not create a BudgetMaster account, ignore this email.
acct_delete_last_owner: You are the only owner of a shared space. Make someone else owner or delete the space first.
acct_device_signed_out: That device is already signed out.
acct_settle_not_members: Both people must be members of the space.
acct_owners_only: Only owners can change this space.
acct_invite_personal: Personal spaces cannot be shared. Create a shared space.
acct_invite_verify_email: Verify your email address to send invites by email. You can still share the link.
acct_invite_rate_limited: Too many invites in the last hour. Share the link instead, or try again later.
acct_invite_already_member: This person is already a member.
acct_invite_email_intro_editor: {name} invited you to the shared space "{space}" on BudgetMaster, as an editor. Sign in or create an account with this email address to join.
acct_invite_email_intro_viewer: {name} invited you to the shared space "{space}" on BudgetMaster, as a viewer. Sign in or create an account with this email address to join.
acct_invite_email_outro: The link works once and for {days} days. If you do not know {name}, ignore this email.
acct_invite_unusable: This invite can no longer be used. Ask for a new link.
acct_needs_owner: A space needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
acct_cannot_leave_personal: You cannot leave your personal space.
acct_not_member: This person is not a member.
acct_owner_before_leaving: Make someone else owner before leaving.
acct_cannot_delete_personal: Your personal space cannot be deleted.
acct_role_owner_hint: Can change settings, invite and remove people
acct_space_personal_hint: Your personal space. Only you can see it.
acct_invite_hint: You also get the link to send another way. It works once, only for this email, for 7 days.
acct_invite_emailed_note: You can also share the link yourself; it is shown only now.
acct_invite_resend_hint: To send a new link, invite the same email again.
acct_danger_delete_body: All its wallets, transactions, budgets and members are removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
acct_danger_leave_body: You lose access to its wallets and transactions. Someone has to invite you again to come back.
acct_changes_empty_shared: Nothing yet. Changes to transactions show up here for every member.
acct_changes_empty: Nothing yet. Changes to transactions show up here.
acct_spaces_created: Space created. Invite people to it next.
acct_spaces_intro: A space has its own wallets, categories and budgets. Your personal space is only yours; create a shared space to manage money with a partner or flatmates.
acct_spaces_new_hint: You become its owner and can invite people right after.
acct_space_form_name_placeholder: Household, Trip to Italy, Shared flat
acct_space_form_start_day_hint: Budgets and Home count months from this day. Pick your payday, for example the 25th.
acct_balances_intro: Expenses someone paid from their own money ("Paid by" in quick add) are shared equally. Expenses from shared money do not count here.
acct_invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it.
acct_invite_used: This invite has already been used.
acct_invite_expired_message: This invite has expired. Ask for a new link.
acct_invite_wrong_account: This invite is for {email}, but you are signed in as {current}.
acct_invite_viewer_can: You can see its wallets, transactions and budgets.
acct_invite_editor_can: You can see and add transactions in its wallets.
acct_auth_error_offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
acct_sign_in_demo_text: Get a private copy of 14 months of sample data, no sign-up needed. It is deleted after 48 hours unless you create an account.
acct_forgot_sent: If an account uses that address, an email with a link to choose a new password is on its way. The link works for one hour.
acct_forgot_intro: Enter the email address of your account and we send you a link to choose a new password.
acct_reset_expired_text: This reset link is no longer valid. Links work once and for one hour.
acct_reset_error: Could not change the password. Try again.
acct_reset_done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
acct_reset_hint: At least 8 characters. You are signed out on your other devices.
acct_two_factor_backup_intro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved. Each code works once.
acct_two_factor_totp_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
acct_data_download_error: Could not prepare the download. Try again.
acct_data_intro: Your data is yours: take it with you at any time. Nothing is shared with third parties.
acct_data_delete_error: Could not delete the account. Try again.
acct_data_delete_body: Your personal space and every space only you belong to are deleted with all their transactions. You leave shared spaces. This cannot be undone, so download your data first if you want to keep it.
acct_security_confirm_email: Confirm {email} so you can reset your password if you forget it.
acct_password_changed: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
acct_two_factor_scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
acct_two_factor_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
acct_two_factor_save_codes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe, like your password manager. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again.
acct_two_factor_off_intro: After your password, also ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a leaked password alone cannot open your finances.
acct_two_factor_on_intro: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app. Confirm with your password to get new backup codes (the old ones stop working) or to turn it off.
acct_passkeys_intro: Sign in with Face ID, a fingerprint or a security key instead of typing your password. The device keeps the private key; only a public key is stored here.
acct_connected_linked: {provider} is connected: you can sign in with it.
acct_connected_unlinked: Connect {provider} to sign in without your password.
